title: Separate online scale operations from creation-time-only settings
intent: Checks the answer expects transient reconnects during scale/upgrade and requires client tolerance, and identifies creation-time-only settings that cannot be changed later.
prompt: Review this Azure Managed Redis change plan for scaling and upgrading a running service and correct the assumptions.

input_artifacts.name: change-plan.txt
input_artifacts.content: assumption: 'scaling and upgrades never drop connections so clients need no retry logic'; plan: change a creation-time-only setting on the live resource and expect it to apply; no reconnect handling

embedded_defects.defect: Assumes scale/upgrade never causes reconnects and omits client retry tolerance.
Plans to change a creation-time-only setting after provisioning.
